## Problem 1 (a)

```{r}
#import dataset and take a brief look at it
library(tidyverse)
nzge <- readRDS("~/r学习/hw4/nzge.rds")
glimpse(nzge)
names(nzge)
unique(nzge$voting_type)
# gruop the dataset
q1 <- nzge %>%
  group_by(election_year, voting_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_votes))

print(q1, n = Inf)

```

According to group_by,we can calculate the total votes of each party and candidate yearly.
